label: 10 November 2026
title: Cubarsí wins Golden Boy; Yamal misses Spain vs Czechia with knee discomfort
deck: Pau Cubarsí is named Golden Boy 2026. Lamine Yamal will not travel to Prague after right-knee discomfort from the Metropolitano. The squad trained without the 11 internationals. Barça sit top of La Liga after the 2-1 win at Atlético.

stories.headline: Cubarsí wins Golden Boy 2026
stories.summary: Pau Cubarsí has been named Golden Boy 2026 by Tuttosport. The 19-year-old centre-back becomes the fifth Barcelona player to win the award after Messi, Pedri, Gavi and Lamine Yamal. He will collect it at the Turin gala on 14 December.
stories.body: Tuttosport announced the result at an event in Sassuolo on Monday afternoon. Cubarsí scored 475 points out of a possible 500 in the vote of 30 European journalists. Diomandé of Real Madrid finished a distant second. He is the first defender to win the award since Matthijs de Ligt in 2018. The year included a La Liga title, the Spanish Super Cup and the World Cup with Spain, where he was named Young Player of the Tournament. Cubarsí finished 12th in the 2026 Ballon d’Or, the highest-ranked defender.

stories.headline: Yamal, Cubarsí and Rodri named in FIFPRO World XI 2026
stories.summary: Lamine Yamal, Pau Cubarsí and Rodri are in the FIFPRO Men’s World XI for 2026. The XI was chosen by a vote of 19,806 professional players. It is the first time three Barcelona players have featured in the same year.
stories.body: FIFPRO released the side on Monday. Yamal and Cubarsí join Rodri in a team that also includes several players from the recent World Cup cycle. The club highlighted the recognition for the three players who have been central to Hansi Flick’s side this season. Rodri has been used mainly as a midfielder after his return from injury; Cubarsí has started almost every league match; Yamal has played every game. The announcement came on the same day Cubarsí was confirmed as Golden Boy.

stories.headline: Yamal ruled out of Spain vs Czechia with knee discomfort
stories.summary: Lamine Yamal will miss Thursday’s Nations League game against Czechia in Prague. He reported right-knee discomfort after Sunday’s 2-1 win at Atlético and has stayed in Barcelona for tests and recovery. The RFEF expects him to be available for England on Sunday.
stories.body: The Spanish federation confirmed on Monday that Yamal and Mikel Oyarzabal will join the squad late. Yamal played the full 90 minutes at the Metropolitano. Tests on Monday morning showed no major structural damage. He will remain in Catalonia for the first part of the week and is expected to report to Las Rozas before the England match at the Metropolitano on 15 November. Oyarzabal is recovering from flu. Victor Muñoz has been called up in their place for the Prague trip. Spain lead Group A3 and have already qualified for the quarter-finals.

stories.headline: Squad trains without the 11 internationals
stories.summary: Hansi Flick led a session at the Ciutat Esportiva on Monday with the players who stayed in Barcelona. Eleven first-team players are away with national teams. Jules Koundé remains out with the ankle sprain; Olmo, Rodri, Espart and Bardghji are also absent.
stories.body: The group that trained included the players not called up and those still recovering. Eric García and Andreas Christensen are available after returning for the Atlético match. The internationals are Joan García, Cubarsí, Pedri, Fermín and Yamal with Spain; Cancelo with Portugal; De Jong with the Netherlands; Gordon with England; Raphinha with Brazil; Livaković with Croatia; and Bernal with the Spain U21s. Flick is expected to work with a reduced squad until the internationals return later in the week. The next league match is against Villarreal at home on 22 November.

stories.headline: Yamal wins La Liga Goal of the Month for October
stories.summary: Lamine Yamal’s opening goal against Real Betis on 17 October has been voted La Liga Goal of the Month. The strike from the edge of the box beat Kylian Mbappé and Hugo Novoa in the final vote.
stories.body: La Liga announced the winner on Monday. Yamal received the ball on the right, beat his man and curled a left-footed shot into the top corner at La Cartuja. Barcelona won 5-2 that day. It is Yamal’s second Goal of the Month award. The same match also produced an assist. He is still expected to rejoin the Spain squad later this week for the England game despite missing the Czechia fixture.

stories.headline: De Jong has played four positions since returning
stories.summary: Frenkie de Jong has featured in four different positions since his return from the knee injury. SPORT reported that Flick has used him as a central midfielder, right-back, centre-back and deeper midfielder in the last two weeks.
stories.body: De Jong started on the bench against Atlético after travelling. He has been available since the Betis match and has been used flexibly while Koundé, Espart and others have been out. Flick has said he likes the options De Jong gives the side. The Dutchman is now with the Netherlands for the international window. He is expected back in Barcelona next week ahead of the Villarreal match.

stories.headline: Fermín’s brace keeps Barça top after 2-1 win at Atlético
stories.summary: Fermín López scored both goals as Barcelona came from behind to beat Atlético 2-1 at the Metropolitano on Sunday. The result leaves Hansi Flick’s side top of La Liga going into the international break.
stories.body: Fermín scored in the second half after Atlético had taken the lead. It was his 100th La Liga appearance. Barça led by two points before kick-off; the win extends that advantage. Raphinha and Yamal both started and contributed. The side is now three points clear of Real Madrid and five clear of Atlético. The next league fixture is Villarreal at home on 22 November. Fermín is with the Spain squad for the Nations League games.

stories.headline: New gym at Camp Tito Vilanova nears completion
stories.summary: Work on the new gym that Hansi Flick requested at Camp Tito Vilanova is in its final stages. SPORT reported that Flick expects the facility to be ready after the international break.
stories.body: Carlos Monfort wrote that the works are nearly finished. Flick has been clear about wanting better facilities for strength and recovery work. The squad will return to full training after the internationals come back. The next competitive match is against Villarreal on 22 November. Several injured players, including Koundé and Olmo, continue individual work at the Ciutat Esportiva.
